decisions.reason: As a check-in mobile app that sits somewhat outside the firm's core security-service strengths and shows no later public signal of market traction, it is likely judged below aspiration and its resources reallocated.

PassBoard was explicitly launched as a named passenger-processing product and is closely tied to airport operations, so a large firm with some slack would likely keep it on the market while demand recovers and learning continues.

The self-service airline check-in solution overlaps with the other 2019 passenger products, and under prolonged uncertainty management would likely simplify the portfolio and concentrate resources on the more distinctive offering.
